scientific_question: What minimum deterministic, provenance-bound descriptive quantities can be derived directly from one real-performance Candidate Period population to describe recurrent timing behaviour and support later performance comparison?
direct_contribution_to_jga_mission: Establish the first scientifically defensible single-performance timing profile directly from validated pre-interpretive temporal evidence.
missing_scientific_evidence: Evidence that a minimum timing profile can be derived reproducibly from a real-performance Candidate Period population without metric or musical interpretation.
why_existing_evidence_is_insufficient: Existing controlled records validate Candidate Period evidence, but no preserved scientific record evaluates a minimum profile on a genuine real-performance recording.
smallest_experiment: Execute the existing observation-through-M92 path twice on one repository real-performance recording, derive only preregistered quantities from each immutable Candidate Period population, and require exact profile equality.
complexity_introduced: Experiment-local derivation and lightweight records only

input.repository_path: recordings/III_Chet Baker - I fall in love too easily.mp3

acceptance_criteria: derived directly from the immutable Candidate Period population
exactly reproduced by two complete executions
bound to input identity, discovery configuration and observation scope
adds non-redundant value to later comparison
falsification_rule: Reject any quantity that fails direct derivability, exact replay, provenance binding, musical neutrality, scientific interpretability or minimum non-redundancy.
profile_equivalence_rule: Canonical JSON payloads must be byte-identical and have identical SHA-256 fingerprints.
